visual.potential_relevance: Promised lead-generation or inbound-call services are directly linked to contacting sales, signing up, selecting a package and making an upfront payment, which is a task-relevant payment-for-promised-return relationship.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames cannot establish whether the services were delivered, whether the payment instructions were completed, who received any payment, or whether the stated business claims were accurate.

visual.observation: An application/add-ons slide advertises landing pages and popup tools including "Cloak-Er & Pesky, Zapper for ZERO Suspension in Ad Networks," alongside instructions to sign up and generate inbound popup calls.
